subject: build: pass CPPFLAGS to bundled deps and src (#4318)
reason: The change is purely to the build system: it appends $(CPPFLAGS) to the compiler invocation lines in the Makefiles of bundled deps (fpconv, hdr_histogram, linenoise), src/, and the Lua module, and persists CPPFLAGS in .make-settings. It adds no code, changes no command, reply, replication, persistence or cluster behavior; binaries built without a custom CPPFLAGS environment are bit-for-bit equivalent in behavior to the parent's. There is no runtime path a fuzzer scenario could reach, so no scenario is needed.
